text:
matt: Quick heads-up — finalizing the RFC review sync for Tue 10:00 PT. Need authors to confirm slots and reviewers to OK timeboxes. Plan is 40m total + 10m buffer.

sara: I can take reviewer for the KV cache one if needed.

jia: I'm author for the authz RFC — confirmed for slot 1. Will post pre-read in ~1h.

priya: I'm listed as reviewer for authz but out 10:05-10:20 PT. If we can move authz to the first 10m, I'm good; otherwise I can delegate to david.

david: I can cover either authz or rollout infra. Prefer authz if priya needs the later slot.

michael: KV cache author — slot 2 is fine for me. Pre-read: short perf graphs + reproducer.

ben: Batching API author — tentative, can swap earlier if we need to reorder.

priyanka: Rollout infra author — I need reviewer bandwidth for 10:30 slot. matt, can you or david be a co-reviewer?

calendar-bot: Meeting created: RFC Review Sync — Tue 10:00 PT — https://calendar.company/meet/abcd (invited: eng).

matt: Draft slot map (timeboxes are strict):
```
1) 10:00-10:10 — Authz RFC — author: jia — reviewers: priya (primary), david (backup)
2) 10:10-10:20 — KV cache optimizations — author: michael — reviewers: sara, ben
3) 10:20-10:30 — Batching API surface — author: ben — reviewers: jia, sara
4) 10:30-10:40 — Rollout infra playbook — author: priyanka — reviewers: matt, david
Q&A / buffer 10:40-10:50
```

sara: That looks good. Suggest we mark items 1 and 3 as "fast-pass" (10m strict) and give 15m to rollout infra if priyanka needs it.

matt: If priyanka needs +5m we'll compress KV cache to 8m. Is that acceptable, michael?

michael: 8m is tight but I can make the pre-read cover the heavy bits so live time is light.

priya: I can free up 10:05-10:20 by swapping an async meeting — keep me as primary for authz.

ben: For batching API — can we surface 1 or 2 concrete API change options in the pre-read? I'll do that.

jia: Pre-read link: https://docs.internal/rfcs/authz-draft (short summary + 6 questions). Please skim before the sync.

matt: Action items before EOD Mon: authors post pre-reads, reviewers confirm availability, call out any swap requests. I'll lock the agenda at 09:00 Tue.

david: FYI I'm juggling oncall — if I drop, matt you'll take my backup reviewer.

priyanka: Confirmed — I might need +5m; if not used we'll hand it back.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m before meeting.

matt: Thanks all — small ask: reviewers, add one-line review goals in the thread (e.g., "focus on API stability") so authors know what to highlight. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll add: "focus on perf regression risk + migration path".

michael: I'll add: "repro steps + perf delta expectations".

matt: Cool. Locking slots at 09:00 Tue unless someone requests a swap before then. Appreciate quick confirms.

priya: Confirmed.

ben: Confirmed.

jia: Confirmed and pre-read uploaded.

matt: Great — talk Tues.

matt: (note) If anything is blocked on infra or testdata, ping eng-infra channel too so we can unblock before the sync.
